message:
5 seating chart rules that save the day:

• Wait for most RSVPs before you start. You only need seats for the people who are coming.
• Keep couples and households at the same table.
• Seat guests near someone they know.
• Keep older guests away from the speakers, and families with young children near an exit.
• Leave a spare seat or two for last-minute changes.

Then print your chart and place cards, free: https://bridalteam.com/wedding-seating-chart?utm_source=facebook&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=2026-12&utm_content=2026-12-17-noon-seating-chart-rules
